title: Better to just buy items separately for cheaper.
text: I don’t feel this was worth the money. The items included were a bit random and only a few of them are very useful to me. There was a under eye cream which is just ok, facial cooling rollers(these are nice), some cream for after sun exposure(also kind of cheap), a cheap foldable backpack(like $3 at daiso and also what am I going to use it for?), low quality shoe insoles, some ugly headbands, and kombucha. It mostly feels like cheap items thrown together. Probably like $15-20 worth of items, being generous. It didn’t make me feel more relaxed lol
label: neutral
